name: identify_customer
description: Link this conversation to a customer. Needs the email used at checkout and one of their order numbers. Returns ok + first name, or an error.

order_number.description: One of their order numbers, e.g. 1042

name: list_orders
description: The identified customer's 10 most recent orders: number, status, date, total.

name: order_details
description: Status, dates, tracking, items and any open return for one of the identified customer's orders.

name: check_return
description: Whether an order can be returned now, days left in the return window, and which items can or can't be returned.

name: start_return
description: Open a return for an order the customer confirmed they want to return. Optionally only some items (SKUs from check_return).

reason.description: The customer's reason, in a few words

skus.description: Only these items; leave out for all returnable items

name: handoff
description: Pass the conversation to a human team member. Use when you can't help with the tools, the customer is upset, or you're unsure.
